summary: Tested the dropdown/bottom-sheet refactor of language & country selectors on pre-login /country-select screen and on the logged-in Profile tab. All flows verified end-to-end via Playwright on mobile viewport (375x667) plus direct backend PATCH calls. No overlapping icons found anywhere; long labels like 'Wielka Brytania' render cleanly without clipping inside both the collapsed field and the bottom-sheet option rows.
action_items: None - feature verified working as intended, no regressions found.
critical_code_review_comments: Select.tsx is a clean, well-documented reusable component; correctly handles loading/disabled states, highlights active option with radio icon, truncates long text via numberOfLines=1 with flex:1 wrapping container so long names (e.g. Wielka Brytania) never clip or overlap.

country-select.tsx: pendingCountry only updates local state on select (no premature save), confirm() correctly persists to AsyncStorage via storage.setItem(LOCAL_COUNTRY_KEY,...) then navigates to /auth with country param passed through - matches spec of 'select != save' until Kontynuuj is tapped.

profile.tsx: selectCountry/selectLanguage both guard against redundant calls (code === current value) and properly set/clear per-field loading flags independently so selecting country doesn't block language dropdown and vice versa; refresh() re-fetches user after PATCH so field updates to the server-confirmed state rather than optimistic-only.
seed_data_creation: None - reused existing seeded user ania_t1@test.pl; temporarily changed her country to GB->DE and language to en during testing, then explicitly reset back to PL/pl via direct PATCH calls at the end of the session so no dirty state was left behind.
context_for_next_testing_agent: This dropdown refactor for country-select.tsx, profile.tsx and the new src/components/Select.tsx is CONFIRMED WORKING with no regressions. Verified in detail: (1) pre-login /country-select renders two clean dropdown fields ('Język aplikacji' / 'Lokalny rynek pracy i wynagrodzenia') with zero icon overlap, tapping opens a bottom sheet (Sheet from TaskSheet.tsx) with radio selection and correct active highlight; selecting a language applies instantly (local state, no API call, verified UI text switched pl->en immediately) and closes the modal; selecting a country only updates the pending/collapsed field, no navigation; 'Kontynuuj'/'Continue' button saves to AsyncStorage (LOCAL_COUNTRY_KEY) and navigates to /auth?country=<code> (tested with GB - 'Wielka Brytania' renders fully without clipping in both collapsed field and sheet option row). (2) Logged in as ania_t1@test.pl -> Profile tab: 'Lokalny rynek pracy i wynagrodzenia' and 'Język aplikacji' both render as single dropdown fields (flag+name[+subtitle for country]) instead of long card lists; selecting Germany in country dropdown shows loading spinner inside the collapsed field, calls PATCH /api/account/country (200, verified via backend JSON), and field updates to 'Niemcy / Nazwy stanowisk w języku niemieckim' after refresh; selecting English in language dropdown calls PATCH /api/account/language (200) and the entire Profile UI language switched pl->en after refresh (headings, subtitles, button labels all translated correctly, including the Local job market caption changed to 'Affects the salary ranges, job boards and job titles in NEWLY generated AI content...'). (3) Regression: Theme/App style section (3 cards: Świeży/Spokojny/Ciemny) renders unchanged below the dropdowns and is still independently selectable (radio highlight); Edit survey / Generate new suggestions / Log out rows all visible and tappable below. (4) Login/register flow on /auth confirmed still working end-to-end: register/login tab toggle works, login with ania_t1@test.pl/test123 succeeds and redirects to the main tab screen, country param pass-through from country-select to /auth via query string confirmed intact (?country=GB observed in URL).
rca_of_issue: N/A - this iteration is a verification pass of a UI refactor, no new bug found. No RCA needed.
